thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty -> REDWOOD-PROD: Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed for /v1/stream (eu-west) over last 5m. 5xx rate -> 7.9%. Paging @sophia.

sophia: I'm on it. Starting triage in #eng-sre. Any known customer impact?

mike: seeing a lot of client disconnects at the gateway. Logs show `net/http: request canceled` and `chunked: unexpected EOF`. Also some `wrote more than the declared Content-Length`.

carla: snippet from proxy logs:```
[2026-03-15T14:02:11Z] proxy.go:421 error=write tcp 10.0.5.12:443->10.0.6.9:52314: write: connection reset by peer
span=request_id=abc123 model=xxl prompt_len=800 seq=42
```

raj: model-pool-3 returning 502s intermittently. Node g3-12 showing CPU spikes + OOM kill around the same timestamps. Could be upstream pressure causing proxy to tear connections.

sophia: ok. Mitigation proposal (live):
  1) throttle fanout on streaming endpoints -> reduce max downstreams to 8
  2) enable route-level fallback to paged endpoint for responses > 512 tokens
  3) increase keepalive between gateway <-> upstream to avoid premature closes
  4) scale model-pool-3 by +2 replicas immediately

support-ops: we have 2 customer cases opened (NPS-44, merchant-1) reporting partial streams + reconnects. Marking as potentially P1 for impacted customers.

mike: running quick checks. Grepping gateway logs: `kubectl logs -n prod deployment/gateway --since=10m | grep -E "chunked|trailer|Content-Length|request canceled"` -> multiple hits. Also seeing a retry storm from a single user agent `messaging-sdk/1.2.0`.

carla: applying scale now: `kubectl scale statefulset model-pool-3 --replicas=5 -n prod` (was 3). Patch applied.

ops-bot: model-pool-3 scaling event accepted, new replicas initializing (IDs: mp3-4, mp3-5). Rolling readiness checks in progress.

mike: patching gateway configmap to set `max_downstream=8` and `streaming.keepalive=45s`. `kubectl apply -f /tmp/gateway-patch.yaml` then rolling restart of gateway pods. Command: `kubectl rollout restart deployment/gateway -n prod`.

ops-bot: gateway config updated, restart initiated. Pods restarting one-by-one.

raj: after scale and gateway restart, 5xx rate dropped to ~1.2% within ~7m. But still seeing older TLS connections producing `chunked: unexpected EOF` for sessions established before restart. Likely client-side cancels + proxy not flushing trailers.

sophia: temporary fallback enabled on route `streaming_long`: fallback_to=streaming_paged duration=20m. This will route large responses to non-streaming path while we stabilize.

ops-bot: Route change applied, rollout id rc-4471234567, rollback window 30m.

mike: also noticed a single high-volume client repeatedly reconnecting and canceling at ~30s. Support reached out; they confirm retries in SDK. Asking them to queue/retry backoff.

support-ops: notified affected customers, offered immediate mitigations and credits. Ticket updates posted.

carla: added temporary proxy fix to avoid sending chunked trailers when upstream had terminated: small guard in `proxy/stream.go`. Shipped as a hotfix to gateway image tag `gateway:2026-03-15-hotfix-1`. Rolling that in now for 2 replicas for canary.

ops-bot: canary gateway hotfix applied to gateway-2. Monitoring logs for `Content-Length` and `chunked` errors.

raj: metrics update: errors dropped to 0.6% after canary + scale + fallback. Residual spikes correlate to older persistent connections; those drain over time.

sophia: customer impact summary: ~2% of streaming sessions in eu-west experienced partial outputs or silent disconnects between 14:00-14:25 UTC. Major customers were impacted intermittently. Support is following up.

mike: root-cause hypothesis: upstream model pool experiencing transient resource pressure -> forced connection closes -> gateway attempts to stream but upstream cancels -> proxy/HTTP stack emits chunked EOF / Content-Length mismatch errors -> client-side cancel + retry storms amplify the fanout.

sophia: immediate action items captured:
  - (P0) revert streaming_long route fallback after 30m if metrics <0.5%
  - (P1) add per-route connection and chunked-trailer metrics to console
  - (P1) expand integration test suite to include chunked/trailer race conditions and long-lived TLS sessions
  - (P2) add a circuit-breaker on fanout by default (max_downstream=8)
  - (P2) contact top-5 affected customers with post-incident notes

support-ops: ETA for stable metrics <0.5% ~1h. We'll keep customers updated.

incident-bot: Incident logged: severity=prod-high, start_ts=4471234567, owners=[@sophia, @mike], incident_channel=#inc-4471234567. Close criteria: 5xx < 0.5% for 30m and no active customer P1 tickets.

sophia: thanks everyone. We'll transition to async postmortem doc once metrics stable. Adding follow-ups to retro board. :white_check_mark:

mike: noted. I'll keep monitoring logs and client UA list for retries.

carla: leaving the gateway canary running for 45m and will start full rollout if stable.

support-ops: will loop in account managers for merchant-1 and NPS-44.

incident-bot: paging cleared for oncall user(s). If anything reappears, new alert will generate separate thread.
